name: Midas mRe7YIELD
oneLiner: mRe7YIELD is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping Re7 Capital DeFi lending, liquidity, restaking, and funding-rate strategies; not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: Liquid Yield Token managed by Midas and Re7 Capital, allocating across institutional-grade DeFi yield strategies including lending, liquidity provisioning, restaking, funding-rate arbitrage, and options arbitrage
pegMechanism: mRe7YIELD is a NAV-accreting liquid yield token rather than a fixed $1 stablecoin; primary-market mint/redeem occurs through Midas rails while secondary-market holders rely on token liquidity and strategy NAV

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

reserves.name: Re7-managed DeFi lending, liquidity, restaking, funding-rate, and options strategies

mintAuthority.summary: mRe7YIELD is a Midas liquid-yield token; new units are minted only by Midas's permissioned issuance role (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE) when greenlisted users deposit through the Midas DepositVault, with NAV conversion settled off-chain by the issuer.

controls.label: Midas issuance manager (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE / DepositVault)
controls.evidence: Midas vault architecture mints the token via a permissioned MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE through the DepositVault against greenlisted deposits; conversion rate is set off-chain by the issuer and token/vault contracts are upgradeable behind MidasAccessControl.

review.evidence: Midas liquid-yield tokens are minted and redeemed exclusively through Midas's permissioned DepositVault/RedemptionVault contracts gated by MidasAccessControl roles (greenlist + mint operator); no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. On-chain owner/role holders not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live on-chain MidasAccessControl role holders and any bridge admin for the Etherlink/Starknet deployments before raising confidence.
